about_the_game:
Only two mini-game contained in this demo version. Check availability and control systems.

  • A score-attack mode where you hop up auto-generated platforms.

  • "Usagi Sand," a game where you control jump power and platform placement to travel as far to the right as possible.

high-score data are available at retail.

TWO Thrusters

With one jump and two thrusters, control the left and right Kiritan Cannon reactions to soar. However, the cannons are off-center, so inertia has a strong effect. Precise skills are required to achieve the jump you want.

Anti-Gravity?

When preparing the Kiritan Cannon, gravity is reduced, making it easier to aim or time your jump effectively.

Two Mini-Games!

What is 東北ずん子・ずんだもん project

These characters were created by SSS LLC as part of efforts to revitalize the Tohoku region following the Great East Japan Earthquake. While the game’s simple mechanics make it accessible even to those unfamiliar with the characters, we hope it will also spark your interest in the girls themselves and the regions that inspired them.
